flow.name: contacts-list-flow
flow.doc:description: One mode per call: ids (one query, up to 50), email/phone search, or paged listing

ee:transform.doc:description: Picks the mode and builds its SOQL; ids together with email/phone is invalid

choice.doc:description: ids cannot be combined with email or phone

raise-error.description: Use one mode per call: ids, email/phone, or page and size

ee:transform.doc:description: Contacts in the common Customer format

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toCustomer from modules::crm output application/json --- vars.rsResult.payload map toCustomer($)

flow.name: contacts-get-flow
flow.doc:description: One contact by Salesforce Id; 404 when it does not exist

ee:transform.doc:description: SOQL by Id (the contract validates the 18-character Id)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import contactFields from modules::crm output application/java --- { soql: "SELECT " ++ contactFields ++ " FROM Contact WHERE Id = ':id'", params: { id: attributes.uriParams.id } }

choice.doc:description: No record means the contact does not exist

ee:transform.doc:description: Contact in the common Customer format

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toCustomer from modules::crm output application/json --- toCustomer(vars.rsResult.payload[0])

flow.name: contacts-create-flow
flow.doc:description: Creates the Contact; an existing email (duplicate rule) or a simultaneous one (unique Email_Key__c) returns 409 (D22)

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the request: the connector replaces the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Create contact, name: ' ++ vars.customerRequest.name ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the creation

flow-ref.name: crm-resilient-call-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls Salesforce through poc-resilience; raises CRM_UNAVAILABLE or CRM_ERROR when it fails

choice.doc:description: Created, duplicate email, or rejected by Salesforce

ee:transform.doc:description: The new Customer with its Salesforce Id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import createdCustomer from modules::crm output application/json --- createdCustomer(vars.rsResult.payload.id, vars.customerRequest)

when.doc:description: The duplicate rule blocked the insert

raise-error.description: A contact with this email already exists

otherwise.doc:description: Salesforce rejected the record for another reason

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Salesforce rejected the contact: ' ++ (vars.rsResult.payload.message default 'no detail')]

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Create contact, id: ' ++ payload.id ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the Id of the new contact

sub-flow.name: crm-query-call-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Runs the SOQL in vars.listQuery through resilience-call

flow-ref.name: crm-resilient-call-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls Salesforce through poc-resilience; raises CRM_UNAVAILABLE or CRM_ERROR when it fails

sub-flow.name: crm-resilient-call-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Runs vars.rsFlow through resilience-call with the source crm; translates a failure into 503 or 502

flow-ref.name: resilience-call
flow-ref.doc:description: Circuit breaker and one retry on connectivity; never raises, leaves vars.rsResult

choice.doc:description: Unavailable (503) or error (502) when the call failed

when.doc:description: Salesforce failed or its circuit is open

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - Salesforce call failed, reason: ' ++ (vars.rsResult.reason default '') ++ ' - ' ++ (vars.rsResult.message default '') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the failure reason and detail

choice.doc:description: Timeout, connection, quota or open circuit is retryable

when.expression: #[output application/java --- do { import unavailableReasons from modules::crm --- unavailableReasons contains vars.rsResult.reason }]
when.doc:description: Salesforce unavailable or out of quota

sub-flow.name: crm-query-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: One SOQL query (vars.listQuery) with a 3 s read timeout; returns the records as a list

salesforce:query.doc:description: Queries Contact with the SOQL of the selected mode

set-payload.doc:description: Reads every record inside the resilient call

sub-flow.name: crm-create-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Creates one Contact; returns { created, id } or { duplicate } or { message } instead of raising for record errors

try.doc:description: A duplicate rule rejection may come as an error or as a failed record

salesforce:create.doc:description: Inserts the Contact; the duplicate rule blocks an existing email
salesforce:create.salesforce:records: #[output application/java --- do { import toContact from modules::crm --- [ toContact(vars.customerRequest) ] }]

ee:transform.doc:description: Created with its Id, duplicate, or rejected with the Salesforce message

on-error-continue.when: #[(error.errorType.namespace == 'SALESFORCE') and (((error.description default '') contains 'DUPLICATES_DETECTED') or ((error.description default '') contains 'DUPLICATE_VALUE'))]
on-error-continue.doc:description: Duplicate rule rejection raised as an error: not a failure of Salesforce
